statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low; concentrated macro and Nvidia catalysts keep Stress elevated.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold; the principal checkpoints are the 08:30 ET data cluster, the U.S. cash open, and Nvidia's results and conference call.
headline: Low Tail, elevated catalyst Stress
body: Tuesday's technology and semiconductor rebound occurred with lower Treasury yields and oil. Overnight index futures are only slightly softer in fresh reporting, while direct intrahour NQ structure remains limited. Wednesday's macro releases and Nvidia create concentrated event Stress without current evidence of persistent one-way Tail structure.

lookbackSummary: Published Tail stayed low through the preceding 24 clock-hours, with one unavailable historical slot; the most recent finalized assessment was 16% Tail, 61% Stress and normal mode.
outlookSummary: Stress rises sharply into the 12:30 UTC U.S. GDP/PCE/durable-goods cluster and cash open, then again around Nvidia results at about 20:20 UTC and the 21:00 UTC call. Tail remains conditional on persistent one-way price structure, failed retracements and aligned cross-asset confirmation.

forecast.analysis: With no major U.S. release in this hour, the forecast assumes two-way overnight trade. Tail would rise only if directional extension persists while meaningful retracements repeatedly fail.
Early Asia remains a structure checkpoint rather than a scheduled event window. Orderly back-and-forth trade would keep Tail low; sustained session-extreme holding would challenge that view.
Mid-Asia liquidity can magnify headlines, but a larger move alone would primarily lift Stress. Tail would require directional efficiency plus shallow or failed retracements.
Late-Asia conditions may become more headline-sensitive. Tail remains low unless price begins holding near an extreme and repeated pullback failures appear.
The Europe transition adds liquidity and cross-asset information. Broader alignment in yields, volatility and semiconductors would matter for Tail only if it reinforces persistent NQ direction.
European cash trading can validate or reject the overnight move. Conflicting cross-assets would favor Stress over Tail; synchronized confirmation with failed pullbacks would raise Tail.
Pre-U.S. positioning becomes more sensitive as the 08:30 ET data cluster approaches. Event importance raises Stress, while Tail would still depend on observed directional persistence.
Macro anticipation can widen ranges before the releases. No result is known in advance, so Tail remains conditional on the price structure actually visible into the data.
Dispersion may rise ahead of GDP, Personal Income/PCE and durable goods. A pre-release drift is insufficient for elevated Tail without shallow retracements and cross-asset confirmation.
Two hours before the data cluster, event sensitivity is high. Tail would remain below block territory unless NQ is already showing sustained extension and failed mean reversion.
The final pre-release hour carries extreme Stress from concentrated macro risk. Tail remains conditional; the key checkpoint is whether the market arrives with an already efficient one-way structure.

The 08:30 ET GDP, income/PCE and durable-goods cluster can trigger rapid repricing. Forecast Tail reaches WATCH conditionally because a surprise plus persistent failed retracements could produce a dangerous path.

The first post-release hour spans price discovery into the U.S. cash open. Tail remains WATCH unless the initial move retraces meaningfully; repeated extension and shallow pullbacks would be the adverse configuration.
Cash-open follow-through is the key test. If the opening auction confirms the macro move and pullbacks fail, Tail can remain WATCH; orderly reversal or two-way trade would reduce it.
After the initial U.S. open, Stress should stay high but Tail can ease if price discovery becomes two-way. Persistent session-extreme holding would delay that normalization.
Midday conditions may normalize if macro repricing stabilizes across yields, volatility and semiconductors. Tail would stay low under orderly retracement and mixed breadth.
Early afternoon is lower-catalyst, but residual macro positioning can keep Stress elevated. Tail remains contingent on whether NQ continues to mean-revert rather than extend one-way.
Late-afternoon positioning begins to overlap with Nvidia anticipation. Stress can rise even without dangerous price structure; Tail still requires persistent directional evidence.
The hour before Nvidia results is a concentrated event-risk window. Forecast Tail approaches WATCH because positioning can become fragile, but no earnings outcome or reaction is assumed.
Nvidia's approximately 20:20 UTC results checkpoint creates extreme event Stress. Tail would be WATCH only if a directional gap or repricing resists meaningful retracement.
The 21:00 UTC Nvidia conference call can generate a second information wave. Tail remains WATCH because guidance/Q&A could extend an initial move, but the forecast does not assume any outcome.
Post-call digestion can remain volatile. Tail would fall if the market develops two-way trade and retracements; it would stay higher if repeated extension persists near session extremes.
Late U.S. trade should carry less event intensity once Nvidia's first reaction is absorbed. Tail remains WATCH only if one-way structure survives; otherwise risk should continue normalizing.
